decide.python: tt.decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today")

choose.python: tt.choose("Which team owns this?", "please route this ticket", options=["the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else"])

tag.python: tt.tag("Which words appear?", "the refund and the shipping", labels=["refund", "shipping"])

score.python: tt.score("How urgent is this?", "maybe later", levels=["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."])

filter.python: tt.filter("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

rank.python: tt.rank("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

find.python: tt.find("Which line asks for money back?", ["good morning", "I want a refund"])
